moments.text: IR view over rugged mountain slopes, crosshair in the middle; a small dark dot sits just above it. Bright white blobs show at both edges.
A smooth dark shade sweeps in from the left and hides the terrain; a bright band crosses at 4.1–4.9 s, then the slopes fade back.
Clear view of a steep ravine; the dark dot sits just below right of the crosshair.
A black frame, then flat grey frames for under half a second.
Zoomed in on lit rock: the dark dot sits upper right of the crosshair; a magenta box marks it 10.1–11.9 s and 14.1–15.9 s.
The dot stays right of the crosshair as ridges slide past; from 20 s a bright ridge fills the lower half, dot near its top.
Haze drifts across and the image dims; the dot fades and is lost near 29.7 s.
Flat light grey frames at 30.1 s, then smooth featureless grey with a soft glow to the end.
